name: Shattered Spine
description: Partial or Total paralysis. Fully immobilized or hobbled until treated. Up to DM to decide.

name: Severed Limb
description: Total loss of limb, requires a replacement. Can't use that hand/leg.

name: Nerve Damage
description: Random twitches in arms, suffer a -4 to anything requiring fine manipulation such as electronics or shooting a gun.

name: Ruptured Eardrum
description: Deafened. Off-guard to any check requiring hearing; can't receive verbal commands (Inspiring Speech doesn't work on them) until treated.

name: Ruptured Artery
description: Bleeding upgrades to 2 damage/round, ignoring armor, until treated

name: Crushed Trachea
description: END check each round or lose one action gasping for air, until treated.

name: Internal Organ Damage
description: Fatigued 1, permanent and stacking with any other Fatigued source, until treated.
